title: The Far Side
subtitle: twelve stops between the gate and the home road
description: The road is walked in order, because the road is the order: gate,
shore, fortress, forest, bridge, watchtower, blaze road, and the
lantern line that does not light until everything behind it is
The watchtower's line is hazard-taped. The expedition drew it
that way on the map first and the canvas is simply agreeing.
